activity.notes: Yulia Tymoshenko was appointed Prime Minister of Ukraine on 4 February 2005 after the Orange Revolution and her powers were terminated by presidential decree on 8 September 2005.

sources.title: Decree No. 144/2005 appointing Yulia Tymoshenko Prime Minister — Verkhovna Rada legislation database
sources.citation_text: The official Ukrainian legislation database records Yulia Tymoshenko's appointment as Prime Minister on 4 February 2005.

sources.title: Presidential Decree No. 1234/2005 ending Tymoshenko's premiership
sources.citation_text: The President of Ukraine terminated Tymoshenko's powers as Prime Minister on 8 September 2005.

sources.title: Resolution No. 7-VI appointing Tymoshenko Prime Minister — Verkhovna Rada legislation database
sources.citation_text: The Verkhovna Rada appointed Yulia Tymoshenko Prime Minister on 18 December 2007, effective immediately.

sources.title: Tymoshenko vacates premier's post — Interfax-Ukraine
sources.citation_text: Interfax-Ukraine reported on 4 March 2010 that Tymoshenko had vacated the Prime Minister's post after the 3 March no-confidence dismissal of her government.

sources.title: Resolution No. 1964-VI formally releasing Tymoshenko — Verkhovna Rada legislation database
sources.citation_text: The Verkhovna Rada formally released Tymoshenko from the office of Prime Minister on 11 March 2010; ATLAS notes this legal cleanup after she had already ceased performing the office on 4 March.
